title: Temporary sleeping area ventilation check
summary: A night setup check for sleeping in one room, car-adjacent shelter, shop back room, school hall, or crowded home without creating carbon-monoxide, heat, smoke, or condensation risk.
content: Core sequence: 1) Keep combustion devices, vehicles, grills, and generators out of and away from sleeping air. 2) Leave a safe airflow path that does not expose people to smoke, rain, insects, or unsafe strangers. 3) Place the most vulnerable sleeper where they can be checked without stepping over others. 4) Recheck temperature, odor, noise, and breathing comfort before the last adult sleeps.
